## Policy Summary

- Intent: The goal of this project is to extend the event publication, registration, and management REST API (Project 1) into a full web platform. This includes building a browser-based web interface using Vue.js for event organizers to manage events, and for attendees to discover, register for, and track events. Email notifications and richer event metadata are also introduced.
- Languages/Frameworks: golang, vue.js, postgresql, docker, swag for API documentation
- Testing: Minimal unit testing will suffice.
- Quality Gates: Standard linting and minimal unit testing.
- Review Policy: No approvals required for pull requests.
- Performance Targets: Default performance targets.
- Deployment Constraints: The application will be deployed via Docker.
